title_zh: 首页新增全站游戏热度榜
title_en: Homepage added global game popularity rankings
content_zh: 首页现已新增全站游戏热度榜：前三名会突出展示，点击可跳转到对应游戏详情页；查看更多可查看前 25 名排行榜，并支持每 5 分钟自动刷新。
content_en: The homepage now includes a global game popularity ranking: the top three games are highlighted, each links to its detail page, and the full top-25 leaderboard can be opened for a quick view with automatic refresh every 5 minutes.
